texts.propertyDescription1:
The JOY Beach Villas are located directly at Hin Kong Beach in Koh Phangan!
​
Imagine a tropical green garden landscape surrounded by palm trees and lush green trees, directly with a perfect view of the sunset – in the JOY tradition meets modernity!
texts.generalPolicy:
General Terms and Conditions

Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully as these conditions incorporate the basis on which bookings for the Joy Beach Villa are accepted. 
We may revise these Terms and Conditions from time to time by updating this posting. The revised terms will take effect when they are posted. 

Early Check-Out
The property reserves the right to charge an early departure fee in the event a guest departs earlier than the original departure date.

Late Check-Out
On request. Please contact the front office of each property. Additional fees may apply.

Deposit & Payment Policy

A deposit of 30% of the booking value is required to confirm your booking.
Remaining payment is required 30 days before arrival.
For reservations with arrival dates less than 30 days away, full payment is required to confirm your booking.

Damage Deposit

Upon checking in, Joy Beach Villas requires a deposit of 20% of your booking value in cash (with a minimum of 5,000THB) or a passport. At check out date, after the Villa is inspected and found to be damage-free, the deposit will be refunded.
texts.cancellationPolicy:
Cancellation Policy

Each rate booked at Joy Beach Villas is subject to our Cancellation Policy as detailed below:

1. If a booking is cancelled up to 31 days before the arrival date, the upfront payment will not be refunded.

2. Booking cancellation less than 31 days prior to arrival date, no refund will be issued.

3. No show, no refund will be issued.

4. In case of a change in arrival date to a further date, no refund will be issued.

5. In case of early check-out, no refund will be issued.

We reserve the right to cancel or modify reservations under the circumstances where it appears that a customer has provided an invalid credit card, engaged in fraudulent or inappropriate activity. 
In addition, we also reserve the right to cancel or amend bookings if they do not adhere to our Terms and Conditions.

As a condition of using Joy Beach Villas booking method, you agree to provide proof of payment to Joy Beach Villas within 48 hours of the time of booking and will indicate the reservation confirmation number on the proof of payment. You will be fully responsible for any banking fees and/or costs required to complete the bank fund transaction(s). Furthermore, you acknowledge that the reservation may be cancelled by Joy Beach Villas if proof of payment is not submitted within the 48-hour notice period.

Relocation

In the rare unexpected event whereby the property cannot provide accommodation as previously confirmed, the property will comply with its standard of obligation by undertaking to relocate guests into an alternative property of equal or better grading at no expense to the guest. Should there not be a property of equal or better grading in the vicinity of the original booking, it may be required to provide guests with a property of a lesser grading. If this is the case, any reduction in costs will be refunded to the guest.
The alternatives offered are at the property’s discretion. Should the guest wish to choose a property of a standard other than offered under this condition, then the guest will be required to pay any difference.

Limitation of Liability

Notwithstanding anything contained in these Terms and Conditions to the contrary, The Joy Beach Villas shall not be responsible for indirect damage, damage arising from consequential damage or special circumstances, including but not limited to loss of revenue, loss of profit, loss of use, loss of opportunity, arisen out of the performance or non-performance of obligations under these Terms and Conditions.

Insurance

The Joy Beach Villas strongly recommends you purchase Comprehensive Travel Insurance. We suggest that the policy include, but not be limited to, the following coverage – loss of payment through cancellation, loss or damage to personal baggage, loss of money and medical expenses.

Governing Law & Jurisdiction
This site is operated from Thailand and it is governed by the laws of Thailand

Our Beach Front Villa offers a large outdoor lounge area, with a breathtaking view over Hin Kong’s Bay and Ang Thong National Marine Park.
The hand-picked furniture and decorations give this Villa a very elegant homy touch, away from home.
Waking up in such decor and walking barefoot on the immediate beach will certainly bring you joy and peace!
These one bedroom Villa comes with a king-size bed. The living room also offers a pull-out sofa.

texts.roomDescription:
Discover unparalleled luxury in this stunning 540 sqm villa nestled above the vibrant village of Srithanu on Koh Phangan, Thailand. Just 5 minutes from Hin Kong Beach, this private Luxury Villa offers tranquility and seclusion amidst lush tropical surroundings.

It features a stunning 14-meter infinity pool, offering an ideal place to relax and unwind.

Three elegant bedrooms feature outdoor showers with breathtaking sea views, while an additional bedroom with a private entrance and en-suite bathroom is conveniently located near the yoga and massage pavilion—ideal for relaxation and rejuvenation.

Embrace the island lifestyle in this luxurious sanctuary designed for comfort, privacy, and serenity.


Guest Notice:We want to inform you that there is some construction happening near the villa, which may occasionally result in noise during the day, typically from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Unfortunately, this is something we cannot control. We appreciate your understanding and patience as this project progresses, and we hope it won't disturb your stay too much.
